definitions.B1: Paper 1 cache channel 0: normalized reconstruction magnitude |x_hat|.
definitions.B2: Paper 1 cache channel 1: normalized zero-filled magnitude |x0|.
definitions.B3: Paper 1 cache channel 2: normalized intervention magnitude |x_hat - x0|.
definitions.B4: Finite-difference gradient magnitude of B1, using the committed Paper 1 gradient_magnitude_2d implementation.
definitions.B5: Paper 1 cache channel 4: analytical Cartesian PSF.
definitions.B6: Paper 1 cache channel 5: normalized sensitivity-aware q_PSF / gain envelope.
definitions.C0: Frozen deterministic Paper 2 C0 mean prediction stored as c0_mean.
definitions.U1: Frozen MC-dropout variance; existing Exp008 Task R record reused without recalculation.
definitions.U2a: Frozen point-ensemble between-model variance; existing Exp008 Task R record reused without recalculation.
definitions.U2b: Frozen probabilistic-ensemble total predictive variance; existing Exp008 Task R record reused without recalculation.

direction_freeze: Larger raw values submitted as higher Task R scores; no sign flipping or test-dependent transformation.
